title: Divine Flesh
wikitext:
{{Passive skill box|Divine Flesh}} '''Divine Flesh''' is a [[keystone passive skill]] that causes you to [[Damage_taken_as|take]] 50% of elemental damage as [[chaos]] damage and grants additional maximum chaos resistance, but causes all damage to bypass [[energy shield]]. ==Mechanics== While this keystone has negative synergy with [[Chaos Inoculation]], it can still be used with [[Eldritch Battery]]. For more information about taking damage as another element, see [[Damage taken as]]. The damage taken over time effect of {{il|Righteous Fire}} and other non-chaos degenerations will also be converted. As such, Divine Flesh can be an excellent way to reduce the degeneration effect, granted that a player has capped their chaos resistance. Divine Flesh will take precedence over modifiers that prevent damage from bypassing energy shield, such as those found on {{il|Shavronne's Wrappings}}, {{il|Solaris Lorica}} or {{il|Emperor's Vigilance}}. This means that all damage will continue to bypass energy shield, making those items negative synergies.{{cite web|url=https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/bwwjzz/give_up_your_flesh_unto_the_gods_and_in/eq1564g/?context=10000|title=Re: Give up your flesh unto the gods, and in vulnerability find strength|author=Mark_GGG|publisher=Official Path of Exile subreddit|date=June 5, 2019|accessdate=December 02, 2023}}
==Location== This keystone can only be obtained by placing a {{il|Glorious Vanity}} unique [[Timeless Jewel]] (only variants that have the modifier {{c|mod|Bathed in the blood of (100-8000) sacrificed in the name of '''Xibaqua'''}}) into a socket on the skill tree, or other unique item that grant this keystone. It is not on the default passive tree. Any keystone within the radius of the jewel's area of effect will be converted (in-game wording: [[conquered]]) into Divine Flesh, allowing the player to allocate it. ==Related unique items== The following [[unique item]]s are related to Divine Flesh: {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where=items.stat_text LIKE "%Divine_Flesh%" OR items.stat_text LIKE "%Conquered_by_the_Vaal%" |large=1 |base_item=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} ==Videos== YrF0S2Jfc1A ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.12.0| * Now grants +5% to maximum Chaos Resistance, down from +10%. }} {{Version history table row|3.7.0| * Introduced to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist}} [[Category:Keystone passive skills]]
